a.lede: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.
a.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion

b.title: Microsoft posts $92.3bn quarterly revenue after offering buyouts to 60,000 employees
